verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Groq hosts open-weight models such as GPT-OSS 120B, but nothing documents how quickly newly released models are added after their public release. No release-timing data, onboarding policy, or day-zero launch claims appear in the pack. Hosting a given open-weight model is catalog presence, not evidence of rapid availability, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
